block/SlimePropaguleBlock.java.note: Java hanging slimy-leaf and grounded slime-soil survival is now registered through PlutoLib, with a passing behaviour regression. The first Ender-tree run produced no surviving propagules; after the support fix, eight normal/tall x ground fixtures pass with 44 surviving propagules and inspected images. Production callbacks use the original bundled settings. Full native build and real-game dry/waterlogged item placement, hanging ages 0–4, support removal, two-stage bone-meal growth and native random-tick maturation/growth passed; six gameplay images inspected. Exact RNG/unloaded-boundary and multiplayer/save parity remain unverified. Frozen legacy handlers remain. Full class parity is not claimed.
